summary: Add pr_watch_probe module for ETag-based PR polling and comment/review deltas (#1078).
migration_impact: No downstream migration until a follow-up PR wires the probe into gh plate pr babysit --watch. Libraries may import plate_core.pr_watch_probe for cheap change detection.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when this ships on the release track.
2. Babysit --watch behavior is unchanged until the watch loop integration lands in a later Epic #1077 slice.
agent_notes: Use probe_pr with a injected or GhApiHttp client for one REST GET per unchanged PR (304). Persist ProbeState under .agentic/babysit/<owner>-<repo>-<pr>.probe.json. fetch_delta loads only new comments and reviews since last_checked_at.
